tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Identity colour — the mark, graphic fills, highlights, the prompt accent. A graphic colour on light grounds (1.71:1 on paper): never text there. As text only on ink/night (8.99:1 on ink, 10.23:1 on night).

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Secondary amber fill: hover on sun fills, chart series. Never text on paper (2.68:1).

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Amber TEXT on light grounds: links, labels, inline emphasis. 4.92:1 on paper, 4.68:1 on code-bg; only 4.47:1 on stone, so keep ember text off stone surfaces.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Warm near-black: body text on paper, the wordmark, hero and terminal-bar grounds. 15.38:1 against paper.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Warm light surface — never pure white. Page ground in light theme; text on ink.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Recessed warm surface: brand-kit page ground, muted panels. Ink reads 13.98:1 on it.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Deepest warm ground: dark-theme page background and terminal body. Paper reads 17.49:1, sun 10.23:1.

tokens.name: mute
tokens.usage: The brand kit's own muted ink (≈#837D76 on paper, 3.9:1). Kept exact for fidelity; FAILS 4.5:1 for small text — use muted-foreground for UI text, reserve mute for decorative captions 24px+ or non-essential ornament.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The brand kit's hairline on light grounds: card, table and section rules. Decorative separation only — not a control boundary.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground. Everything sits on this.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text on background, card and popover (15.38:1 light, 17.49:1 dark).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card, panel, table and tile surfaces. Separated from background by border, not shadow.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips, dropdowns.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Default button fill and strongest interactive surface: ink on paper, paper on night — so it never competes with the sun variant.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text/icons on primary (15.38:1 light, 17.49:1 dark).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill and quiet chips.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary (12.91:1 light).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: sidebar, table header, inline-code wells, skeletons.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text — captions, meta, descriptions. 5.82:1 on paper, 5.29:1 on stone; dark 6.69:1 on night, 5.88:1 on ink.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover/active background for ghost buttons, menu and nav items.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions, the kit's DON'T tag. Text 6.68:1 on paper; dark 7.16:1 on night. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a destructive fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Passing / ok states: conformance passes, the kit's USE tag, terminal ok. 6.38:1 on paper; dark 8.25:1 on night. Differs from destructive in word/icon, never hue alone.

tokens.name: success-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a success fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline between surfaces: cards, tables, separators, header rule. Decorative.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Form-control and outline-button borders — 3.53:1 on paper, 3.58:1 dark: meets the 3:1 control-boundary floor.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset. Ember 4.92:1 on paper; sun 10.23:1 on night.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline link text. Underline on hover; never on stone surfaces in light theme.

tokens.name: sun-soft
tokens.usage: Soft highlight: active sidebar item, text selection, search-hit marks. Ink on it 12.61:1.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: The hero / cover ground — ink in both themes, the brand's signature placement for the sun mark.

tokens.name: inverse-foreground
tokens.usage: Headline text on inverse.

tokens.name: inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Lede text on inverse, as in the brand-kit cover (~9:1 on ink).

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code block surface.

tokens.name: code-foreground
tokens.usage: Plain code text on code-bg.

tokens.name: inline-code-bg
tokens.usage: Inline code chip behind Plex Mono identifiers.

tokens.name: syntax-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords (pub, fn, async, trait) — as on the docs.rs mock. 4.68:1 / 9.58:1 on code-bg.

tokens.name: syntax-string
tokens.usage: String literals. 6.06:1 / 7.73:1.

tokens.name: syntax-number
tokens.usage: Numbers, lifetimes and literals. 6.34:1 / 6.11:1.

tokens.name: terminal-bg
tokens.usage: Terminal body — same in both themes.

tokens.name: terminal-bar
tokens.usage: Terminal title bar.

tokens.name: terminal-fg
tokens.usage: Terminal output text, 11.34:1 on terminal-bg.

tokens.name: terminal-dim
tokens.usage: Dim terminal text from the showcase. Kept exact; 3.88:1 — FAILS 4.5:1, so never carry essential information in it.

tokens.name: terminal-ok
tokens.usage: Terminal success verbs (Adding, ok). 8.25:1.

tokens.name: terminal-prompt
tokens.usage: The ❯ prompt glyph. 10.23:1.
